tonight.headline: Down 64.8 — Allen and Jefferson tonight, an 8% chance
body: Bad news first: every Sunday game went against you — Allgeier 6.6, Gordon 7.4, Diggs 8.1, Tuten 8.9 — and Talla Metralla finished at 141.12 against your 76.3.

Allen and Jefferson play Minnesota-Buffalo at 19:15 CDMX and need 64.8 between them; ESPN projects 38.6 and gives you 8%. Both are already in the lineup. Jefferson catches from Carson Wentz — Murray is out with the hamstring, already priced. Nothing to set tonight.

case.label: The script that wins it
case.body: Allen 40-plus and Jefferson 25-plus in the same game. Talla Metralla have no one left to play.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Allen and Jefferson combine for 64.8 or more — then AVIATO win and 8% was too pessimistic.
